Uttarakhand CM Highlights Expressway, Credits Predecessors for State Progress

Uttarakhand Chief Minister Pushkar Singh Dhami has inaugurated a new expressway, stating it will bring Dehradun closer to the National Capital Region. In separate remarks, Dhami also credited all his predecessors, including N.D. Tiwari, for the state's development, emphasizing a collaborative approach to progress.
